description: This Bash script automates the building and testing of a Docker image for an 'openclaw' project. It builds a Docker image, runs a container with customized environment variables, stubs systemd/loginctl commands, installs the project using npm, and verifies the correct setup of systemd service units by checking entrypoints. The script contains functions for simulating systemctl and loginctl behavior, and orchestrates a series of test flows to validate switch behaviors between npm and git configurations.

methods.name: assert_entrypoint
methods.description: Verifies that the systemd unit file contains the expected ExecStart entrypoint by parsing the file and comparing the value.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Automates a test flow by installing a service, running the doctor, and checking that the entrypoint switches accordingly. It setups a temporary home directory, executes install and doctor commands, and verifies the systemd unit's ExecStart entrypoints.
